params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a stylized 3D adventure RPG, side-view diorama cutaway of a small rooftop bedroom-workshop in Guayaquil, Ecuador, golden hour. Center: a chibi engineering student, three heads tall, short dark curly hair, warm brown skin, utility jacket, cargo pants, sneakers, crossbody tool bag. On the workbench a small curious cat with a glowing cyan collar tag sits beside an open book projecting a cyan hologram of a ringed planet. Soldering iron, oscilloscope, circuit boards, small telescope, model satellite, ceiling fan, tropical potted plants. Open window: hillside of colorful houses with a lighthouse above a wide river, orange sky. Foreground plants and crates, layered depth. Warm sunbeams, cool teal shadows. Art style: layered papercraft and ink, scenery built from cut textured paper layers with deckled edges and soft drop shadows, flat gouache fills, fine ink-line engineering sketches and star-chart diagrams as wall decoration, matte 3D characters with graphic silhouettes, palette of warm paper, clay red, dark ink teal, gray-green and a turquoise accent. No text, no logos, no interface.
